user.title: Add SmartButtons panel
user.description: Home Assistant usually finds panels by itself. Use this only if it does not.

confirm_local.title: SmartButtons panel
confirm_local.description: Panel **{name}** ({host}) is managed locally. Adding it switches it to Home Assistant and restarts it. Pages and entities are taken over, the token on the panel is no longer used.

error.cannot_connect: Panel not reachable. Does it run firmware v0.6.0 or later?
error.adopt_failed: The panel did not confirm the switch. Wrong password?

abort.paired_elsewhere: The panel is paired with another Home Assistant. Hold SW6 and SW10 for 5 seconds while it powers on, then add it again.
